sources.label: Morphe patches to remove ads, analytics, apk junk, debug info, duplicate graphic
sources.author: BlazeFTL
patch_list: Adds Close duplicate tabs to the tab tray 3 dot menu. Toggle in Mod Settings.
Removes the toast shown when a video goes fullscreen. Toggle in Mod Settings.
Long press to select tab range
In tab tray selection mode, long press a second tab to select every tab between. Toggle in Mod Settings.
New tab next to current tab
Opens new tabs right after the current tab and adds an add-to-end button (+ with a down arrow) beside + that opens a tab at the end. Both are toggles in Mod Settings.
Old style 3 dot menu And Extension Pinning
Adds "Mod Settings" to the 3 dot menu: switch between the stock bottom sheet menu and the old style popup menu, and pin extensions to the search bar.
Keeps the tab tray scroll position when it is closed and reopened.
Adds up and down buttons beside + in the tab tray that jump to the first and last tab. Toggle in Mod Settings.
